name: unshrinkdef
change_made: Defensive SPM target: leave-season-out RAPM rescaled to undo ridge shrinkage. Offensive target unchanged.
notes: With/without residual, defense: z -7.1.

name: outside_labels
change_made: SPM trained on 1-3 season box-score samples, each labeled with RAPM from seasons outside the sample (was career RAPM).

name: outside_reweighted
change_made: Exp 25 with training rows weighted by label possessions.
notes: Worse than 25.

name: team_context
change_made: Team-context features added to SPM: RAPM decomposition terms (teammates, opponents, context), same-team flag, garbage-time and score-margin exposure, playoff share. Ratings computed with the same-team flag off.
notes: Better predicting the prior season, worse predicting the next: tilts toward veterans.

name: team_intercept
change_made: Exp 26 plus a team-season random intercept in SPM.
notes: Same veteran tilt as 26.

name: age_adjusted
change_made: SPM labels age-adjusted to the player's age in each training sample (aging curve).
notes: Overcorrects: 2026 Curry 92nd, Durant 136th. Spearman vs. consensus 0.818.

name: trade_weight
change_made: SPM training rows weighted by team mobility (Gini-Simpson of team possession shares, floor 0.5).
notes: Significant, but one-team players get half weight. Not adopted for that reason.

name: adjacent_labels
change_made: SPM labels from adjacent seasons: 2-, 4- or 6-season windows split in half, each half labeled with the other half's RAPM. Same-team flag added; ratings computed with it off.
notes: Rank order better, spread too wide. 2026 LeBron 126th.

name: flagtest
change_made: Exp 30 models, ratings computed with the same-team flag on for every player.
notes: Flag does not help players who changed teams. Spearman vs. consensus 0.864.

name: swapadj
change_made: Within-team credit reallocation from lineup pairs that differ by one player (player-archetype model, half weight).
notes: Rank order much better (scale-adjusted z -10.0); spread 12-27% too wide.

name: swapheld
change_made: S1 with each team's within-roster rating spread held fixed.

name: onoff
change_made: On-court and off-court net ratings (offense and defense) added to both SPMs.
notes: 2026: Ajay Mitchell 9th to 7th; Caruso and Hugo Gonzalez +0.9.

name: net
change_made: On/off differentials replace raw on-court ratings in both SPMs.

name: stack_q3
change_made: Stacked SPM: elastic net on on/off ratings plus gradient boosting on box-score features, blended.
notes: Four changes at once. 2026 Zach Edey 8th.

name: calibc
change_made: Post-hoc calibration: one multiplier per side on final ratings, fit on within-season holdout games.
notes: Superseded by 33b. Earlier record: 8.648, z -4.1; saved output reads 8.645, z -3.5.

name: priorshrink
change_made: SPM component of each rating shrunk toward zero (offense x0.72, defense x0.95), multipliers fit on within-season holdout games.
notes: Adopted 2026-10-03. Current baseline.

name: shotmix_pin
change_made: Teammate shot-quality lift added to offensive SPM: teammates' expected points per FGA (league make rate by shot distance) with the player on vs. off court, empirical-Bayes shrunk.
notes: Re-scored 2026-10-05 with the prior-shrink multipliers pinned to the baseline's (2017-2026 folds); the first run's apparent win (8.597, z -2.6) came from a stronger shrink fit on 1997-2026 folds. Now a tie. 2026 offense: Edwards -0.50, Brunson -0.46, Murray -0.40; Paul George, Draymond Green +0.49.

name: base_b3
change_made: Baseline for the scorecard: RAPM with a linear box-score-only SPM as its prior (13 box rates per 100 box-estimated possessions plus minutes share), penalty and prior multipliers tuned on other seasons only.
notes: Experiment 35, re-run 2026-10-05 without the stray game-index time trend (exp 37 stage 0). Beats OpenRAPM as shipped year over year (z -2.75, 20 of 28 seasons); within season OpenRAPM leads at z +1.8; orders teammates better on held-out lineup swaps. A reference row.

name: base_b4
change_made: RAPM centered on OpenRAPM's own boosted box prior (raw, before its free scale), penalty pair and prior multipliers tuned on other seasons only, exactly as the linear-box-prior baseline (exp 35).
notes: Re-run without the stray time trend (exp 37 stage 0). Under identical tuning the linear box prior beats OpenRAPM's prior: year over year z +3.7 against B4, within season z +2.3. Our prior's offensive weight falls as games accumulate; the box prior's rises.

name: portable
change_made: Second rating per player-season for players on a new team: box-prior part kept, plus-minus part beyond the box score (RAPM games part + swap adjustment) x0.51, the share that holds up on a new team, fit against same-tier players who stayed.
notes: Not a replacement; shown next to the team rating. Share that holds: 0.49 (SE 0.12) mid-season trades, 0.56 (SE 0.17) off-season moves. Movers rate 0.8-1.0 pts/100 below stayers (paired t -19 / -21) but play to their rating on a new team (level -0.07 O / +0.23 D, SE 0.12-0.13). Held-out error for movers: t -0.4 / -0.9 (n.s.). Box-part ratio unstable (1.32 vs 0.92), held at 1. 2026: Harden 46th to 15th, LeBron 70th to 25th; Queta -0.80.

name: giveback_flat
change_made: Swap adjustment: each team's net type prediction taken back as the same amount from every player of the team (flat), instead of in proportion to each player's share of the team's possessions (shipped).
notes: No give-back at all (team totals move): team-game z +13.2, stint z +11.7 -- the team constraint is essential. Flat: stint level better in every tier (z -1.8 top 30 to -9.0 for 301+); team-game worse for top 30 to 91-150 (z +4.1 / +2.4 / +2.4). 2026 median move 0.06; Derrick White 1.25 to 1.47 (88th to 66th); consensus 0.839 vs 0.834.

name: quality_logistic
change_made: Opponent threes in the defensive target priced at each shot's quality from the current logistic shot model (after its own make or miss) times the shooter's other-half skill, instead of his flat other-half 3P%.
notes: Two thirds of this loss was noise from the box-score prior's training groups changing (see 42f and C1): with every player's prior trained alongside the same players as now, +0.043 (z +1.3), no gain. 2026: Ighodaro 18th to 46th (the three-point pricing itself), Caruso's rise to 14th was the noise. Team level: the quality target predicts points allowed slightly better (0.728 vs 0.726).

name: quality_trees
change_made: As experiment 42, with the shot quality from boosted trees on top of the current logistic (threes toned down 13%).
notes: Fails on its own (z +1.8) and is not better than 42 head to head; its target is almost the same as 42's (r 0.995), the difference in ratings is noise from the box-score prior's training groups.

name: quality_logistic_pinned
change_made: As experiment 42, with every player's box-score prior trained alongside the same players as in the current ratings (62 --deal_target_def=x3def_w0.25), so only the three-point pricing changes.
notes: The fair test of 42: +0.043 (z +1.3, 23 of 56), stint z +2.2, no tier better. 79% of players would otherwise have been trained alongside different players. Ighodaro still drops (18th to 46th); Caruso does not rise (42nd to 50th).

name: redeal_incumbent
change_made: Control: the current ratings, nothing changed except which players each defensive box-score prior is trained alongside (a different, equally balanced split of the league; 62 --deal_seed=1).
notes: Costs +0.056 (z +1.2, 25 of 56) on its own: how much a target experiment pays just because its labels move players to other training groups. Every target experiment so far has paid this; 2026 Caruso 42nd to 14th from this alone.

name: prior_avg5b
change_made: Replicate of 43 with five other player groupings (5-9), none shared with 43 (62 --prior_groupings=5 --prior_grouping_first=5).
notes: Against 43: +0.052, z +1.7 (C1, one regrouping: +0.056).

name: prior_avg5
change_made: Box-score prior averaged over 5 player groupings: each player's prior is the mean of 5 out-of-player booster predictions, each trained without him on a different, equally balanced split of the other players (62 --prior_groupings=5).
notes: Replicate 43b (groupings 5-9): -0.015, z -0.3. Prediction slices better (year-over-year, stint, player groups, with/without): 42 of 47 (43), 34 of 47 (43b), 8 of 47 for one regrouping (C1). Lineup-swap defense order slightly worse in both. Two 5-averages differ per player by sd 0.23 (total, 1,000+ poss) vs 0.39 for one regrouping. Tab: Robust review.

name: lgb_folds
change_made: Box-score prior learner swapped from chimeraboost to a deterministic LightGBM (no subsampling, fixed trees; tuned on 2026+2015 out-of-player screen), today's 5 player folds kept (62 --booster_params=lgb1).
notes: Prior alone better (team-game z -1.3), raw ratings better (z -1.1), even after prior shrink (z +0.5), worse after swap adjustment (z +2.2); stint level worse from the raw stage (rescaled z +5.0). Downstream constants were fitted on chimeraboost priors. 2026: extreme defensive priors (Edey 2.2 -> 4.1).

name: lgb_lopo
change_made: As 44, plus leave one player out: every rated player's prior from a LightGBM fit on every other player's rows, no folds (62 --booster_params=lgb1 --lopo=1).
notes: Prior alone better (team-game z -1.9), raw ratings better (z -1.2), even after prior shrink (z -0.1), worse after swap adjustment (z +1.6); vs 44 a tie (z -0.5). Defensive with/without better (8 of 9 slices). 2026: Edey 39th -> 4th (590 poss), Caruso 42nd -> 6th, SGA 6th -> 17th.

name: lgb_folds_rs
change_made: Rematch of 44: same raw ratings, prior-shrink multipliers refitted on LightGBM's own within-season folds (97 --tag=lgb1_within) instead of chimeraboost's.
notes: Multipliers offense 0.70-0.73 (same as chimeraboost), defense 0.88-0.92 (chimeraboost 0.92-0.97). After the shrink a tie (z +0.1); final still worse (z +2.2). Stint level worse from the raw stage.
command: SKIP_BUILD=1 SHRINK_TAG=lgb1_within bash scripts/experiment_chain.sh lgb_folds_rs x3def_w0.25

name: lgb_lopo_rs
change_made: Rematch of 44b: same raw leave-one-out ratings, prior-shrink multipliers from LightGBM's own within-season folds (the five-fold models'; leave one out keeps no models).
notes: After the shrink a tie (z -0.4); final worse (z +1.5): the swap adjustment helps chimeraboost 4x more (-0.008 vs -0.002). Ratings more team-driven (team share of defense 0.176 vs 0.162).
command: SKIP_BUILD=1 SHRINK_TAG=lgb1_within bash scripts/experiment_chain.sh lgb_lopo_rs x3def_w0.25

name: lgb_noonc
change_made: LightGBM prior (44's settings, five player folds) with the on-court inputs removed: on-court plus-minus and on-court possessions (62 --booster_params=lgb1 --features=boruta_noonc).
notes: Adopted 2026-10-08 (owner: keep the one that likes Butler/Jokic/Edey and drops Hugo/Ajay/Oso). Passes the rule (z -2.4); stint z -9.1; 36 of 47 prediction slices better; lineup-swap 11 of 12 better; team share of defensive rating 0.079 (incumbent 0.162). Offense with/without worse (8 of 9 slices). Consensus defense 0.788 (0.816). Unattributed: chimeraboost without on-court inputs not run.

name: weightfix
change_made: The Robustness pass, experiment 1: the box-score prior trains on body weight in pounds, the input it always meant to read, instead of the possessions behind each training row's label, which had been written over it; everything else as the incumbent.
notes: Adopted 2026-10-09 as the base of the Robustness pass, not published. Year over year better only in the look-back direction (-0.23, z -3.6; forward +0.03, z +0.6); held-out within season a tie (+0.06, z +0.9); defensive body-weight lean +1.26 -> +1.02; bench players up about 0.3 per side; consensus total 0.805 vs 0.820. The look-back gain is not the career-count leak (the fixed prior leans on it less).

name: honestscale
change_made: Robustness pass, exp 2: the SPM prior's scale in the ridge is cross-fitted honestly; each of the 5 game folds rebuilds every box-score input from its own training games (62 --crossfit=honest), where before the scale was fit on box scores that included the held-out fold. Everything else as exp 46.
notes: Not adopted 2026-10-09. Year-over-year +0.123 (z +3.4, 21 of 56): fails the +2 veto. Prior scale -14% offense, -9% defense. Within-season holdout: better before prior shrinkage (-0.59, 10 of 10 seasons), worse after it (+0.097, z +4.1, 0 of 10; noise control +0.070); shrinkage fit on held-out games already corrects the in-sample scale. Worse than the noise control in every year-over-year slice family and on defensive with/without residual. High-volume scorers more underrated on offense (+0.15 to +0.19, bottom decile to top).

name: padonce
change_made: Robustness pass, exp 3: career and 2-3 season training rows of the SPM prior padded once on their summed box counts (possession-weighted k and padding target), instead of averaging each season's padded rates (62 --pad_once=1). Single-season rows unchanged; everything else as exp 46.
notes: Stopped at first pass 2026-10-09 (2017-2026). Within-season holdout +0.039 (z +0.9, 5 of 10; noise control +0.070). No targeted bias moved: defensive steals -0.32 to -0.31, defensive blocks +0.61 to +0.61, defensive rebounds +1.39 to +1.33 (bottom decile to top); largest change of any bias 0.06. Ratings moved SD 0.23 per side, half the noise control's, along no axis. Multi-season row padding is not the cause of the steals bias.

name: ownside
change_made: Robustness pass, exp 4: each SPM prior reads only its own side's box score; the defensive prior drops points, TS%, FGA and usage, the offensive prior drops steals (62 --features=boruta_noonc_ownside). Everything else as exp 46.
notes: Not adopted 2026-10-09. Year-over-year +0.054 (z +1.3, 23 of 56); stint z +2.6; lineup-swap net order z -2.3; defensive Spearman vs. consensus 0.765 vs. 0.780; offensive with/without residual better (z -2.6). Within-season holdout +0.178 (z +1.6; noise control +0.070). Without the scoring inputs, high-usage players' defensive ratings rise about 1.1 pts/100 (top decile vs. bottom) and holdout games say they are now overrated (usage bias -0.58 to -1.48, z -27): the scoring inputs are real defensive signal. Offensive steals bias -0.40 to -0.30.

name: groupfix
change_made: Robustness pass, step 13 (last resort): prior shrinkage refit jointly with 6 group-calibration lines fit on other seasons' within-season holdout games (defense: size group, steals; offense: size group, 3PA volume group, turnovers group, personal fouls), applied per player and re-centered (140_group_correction.py in place of 99). Raw ratings as exp 46.
notes: Not adopted 2026-10-09 (135 veto). Year-over-year +0.051 (z +1.1, 21 of 56); 135: year-over-year slices 2 better / 9 worse vs. noise control 7 / 4. Within-season holdout -0.255 (z -3.2, 8 of 10). Counted biases on 30 seasons 35 -> 10. Lineup-swap defense order z +2.6, gaps z -4.1; offensive with/without residual z -2.7. Spearman vs. consensus: defense 0.759 vs. 0.780, total 0.791 vs. 0.805. Year-over-year wants the corrected defense scaled 0.90 (base 0.98). Attribution (50b): lines with the shipped multipliers cost more (z +3.0), so the loss is in the lines. Side split: offense-only +0.003 (z +0.1), defense-only +0.046 (z +1.3).

name: groupfix_hold
change_made: Attribution arm for exp 50: the same 6 group-calibration lines fit on what the shipped prior shrinkage leaves, shrinkage multipliers held at their shipped values (140 --hold_multipliers=1).
notes: Diagnostic. Year-over-year +0.145 (z +3.0, 18 of 56), worse than exp 50's joint refit (+0.051): the year-over-year loss comes from the lines; refitting the multipliers with them offsets part of it.

name: groupfix_spread
change_made: Exp 50's ratings order with exp 46's spread: every season and side of exp 50's final table rescaled about its possession-weighted mean to the base's possession-weighted SD (offense x0.988, defense x0.865).
notes: Not adopted 2026-10-09; exp 46 published instead. Year-over-year +0.031 (z +0.7, 23 of 56): forward -0.064 (z -1.1), back +0.126 (z +2.4); order-only z +0.8. Lineup-swap: defense order z +2.6, gaps z -4.6; offense order z +1.1; total order z -0.9. Offensive with/without residual z -2.7. Spearman vs. consensus: defense 0.758 vs. 0.780. 135 year-over-year slices 3 better / 8 worse vs. noise control 7 / 4.
